verdicts.reason: A keeps 'Chase the light' and 'Sparkling botanicals' together as one readable block in a sensible left-to-right banner order. But the SOLSTICE logo and the can are tiny, the label on the can can't be read, the logo/can/headline are spaced unevenly, and a stray sparkle dot sits right next to the oversized CTA. B has the same tiny logo and can and the same stray dot, but it also pushes 'Sparkling botanicals' down to the bottom edge at a size too small to read, away from its headline, so the headline and subline no longer read as a group and the tagline is effectively lost.
